def apply_horizontal_mirror(grid):
    """Apply horizontal mirroring to each 5x5 region."""
    # Regions are at cols: 0-4, 6-10, 12-16, 18-22
    # (borders at 5, 11, 17, and the last region ends at 22)
    regions = [
        (0, 5),   # cols 0,1,2,3,4
        (6, 11),  # cols 6,7,8,9,10
        (12, 17), # cols 12,13,14,15,16
        (18, 23), # cols 18,19,20,21,22
    ]
    
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    for r_start, r_end in [(0, 5), (5, 11), (11, 17), (17, 23)]:
        for c_start, c_end in regions:
            width = c_end - c_start
            for r in range(r_start, r_end):
                # Swap columns j and width-1-j for j in 0 to width//2-1
                for j in range(width // 2):
                    swap_col = c_start + j
                    mirror_col = c_end - 1 - j
                    if swap_col != mirror_col:
                        result[r][swap_col], result[r][mirror_col] = result[r][mirror_col], result[r][swap_col]
